cold_start_definition: share of transcribed bot calls whose first bot turn is the generic 'kya aap <company> se bol rahe hain?' check, i.e. the call starts from nothing

examples_non_identity.asked: Ji, vaise aap kin products mein deal karte hain? Matlab kya bechte hain aap IndiaMART par?

note: Identity checks ('kya aap X se bol rahe hain?') are partly a safety step (wrong-person guard); with the file they become a confirmation ('Hello X, ...'), not a question. Category/location asks are pure re-asks.
